about_the_game:
Weed Wacker Warrior is a Top-Down, 2D, Action game following George and Ken, two college students working a summer job, as they fend off an invasion of evil yard weeds attacking their town. Use common yard tools such as Weed Wackers, Lawn Mowers, and Axes to fight off dozens of weeds all while being forced to perform mundane work tasks by their boss. 

Story: 

George and Ken are working a normal, 90 degree workday at their summer job, when suddenly the weeds surrounding them come to life and begin to attack them, draining all of the water and moisture from their body as they are hit. The boys quickly learn to fight off the weeds using their tools with the help of their mentors and coworkers, Jimbo and Hughbert, and begin to fend off onslaughts of weeds created by the evil god Viridian. George and Ken face multiple types of common garden weeds at different locations in their town, all while trying to set up and prepare for the towns annual 4th of July summer festival, and facing the expectations of their boss and mayor of the town, V.V.

Enjoy a story filled with fun jokes, cheesy one liners, and unexpected twists and turns when you least expect it!

Your Tools:

George and Ken are able to use a variety of different common tools that behave in different ways based on the type of tool they are using.

Weed Wackers well rounded tool that they use in a variety of ways to fight weeds on the daily. 

Lawn Mowers are quick moving and rapid damage dealing tools great for taking out smaller weeds that grow in large groups.

Axes are slow to swing, often needing to charge up to attack, but pack a huge punch. Larger weeds never stand a chance against them.

Experiment with different combinations of tools that George and Ken come up with!

The work day: 

Despite facing unprecedented evil, there's still work to be done, and no money in the budget to dilly dally. George and Ken have to complete daily work such as cutting normal grass, picking up trash, and setting up decorations for the festival. 

And don't worry, you're still only paid minimum wage!

Meet a variety of crazy characters that live in the township, and even help some of them along the way. Many of these characters may even help you find secrets, or aid you on your journey. And at the end of the day, sometimes you need to kick back, whether its grabbing a drink at the gas station, going fishing, or taking care of your pet goose, there's always plenty to do in the town of Township. 

Enjoy an original sound track with a variety or different tunes. From 8-bit and chilled, to guitar riffs and break core, you're sure to hear something you like!

Have a little sibling, child, niece, nephew, or even your grandma that wants to play? You're in luck. Weed Wacker Warrior has local multiplayer. By plugging in 2 controllers and enabling the state of the art "Little Sibling Mode" you no longer have to give them an unplugged controller! A second player can join in as the following character and provide support to player one!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128 mb
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

  • Additional Notes: This runs on a 5 year old Intel NUCi3 that ran 24/7
